summary: Added public provenance::mark_in_place(&mut Value, &str), returning unit, and made marked(Value, &str) delegate to it. Annotation now supports a caller-owned mutable value without cloning or temporarily taking the document. Existing field-presence logic, declaration order, unknown-command handling, and non-object behavior are preserved. Added six integration tests covering payload and string-allocation preservation, all non-object variants, empty versus present values, nested array paths, annotation order, stale annotations, repeat annotation, and equivalence with marked. Existing source tables, public structs, manifests, lockfile, toolchain, and tests were left unchanged.
